tool_args.rationale: The history gap and transient lag support a coupled memory ODE. The fine-trajectory batch adds the time-resolved observations needed to separate the memory timescale from the direct relaxation rate before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five prefixes share the same sampling and switch schedule, and the forecast horizons span only 0.36–0.52. A close fit could trade off memory decay, coupling strength, and direct relaxation.
It cannot explain the endpoint-matched history gap because it has no state that retains prior input.
The unresolved question is how the transient depends on input history, not which sink-gradient branch applies.
